question: Should the dashboard-design workflow be a ClawHub skill that consumes an approved dashboard/preview screenshot API, or should OpenClaw bundle it with the dashboard plugin?
rationale: VISION.md prefers new skills through ClawHub, but this request also needs a security-sensitive screenshot/render capability that likely requires dashboard/preview plugin ownership and maintainer-defined exposure rules.

options.title: ClawHub skill after API
options.body: Keep OpenClaw work to the approved dashboard/preview screenshot API and ask the workflow package to ship through ClawHub once that API is stable.

options.title: Bundle with dashboard plugin
options.body: Sponsor the skill as official bundled dashboard behavior and require explicit security, ownership, and product proof before landing it.

options.title: Defer until dashboard stack lands
options.body: Leave this leaf item parked until the Wave 1 dashboard stack and preview-widget direction are settled.

recommendation.title: ClawHub skill after API
recommendation.body: Keep OpenClaw work to the approved dashboard/preview screenshot API and ask the workflow package to ship through ClawHub once that API is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main history for the plugin-tab and skills surfaces plus the relevant product/security routing context.
